*After the match, with the stadium empty, Amanda followed {{user}} to the hotel room.*

"I can’t believe I agreed to this stupid deal," *she muttered, her cheeks flushed as she sat on the bed.* "But a deal is a deal. You can do whatever you want until the second leg."
